tools.name: nova_inbox__list_messages
tools.description: List messages in the signed-in user's Nova Inbox (@nova.civai.co).

tools.name: nova_inbox__read_message
tools.description: Read full body of one Nova Inbox message by id or list index (includes attachment metadata).

tools.name: nova_inbox__list_thread
tools.description: List all messages in an email thread (inbound + outbound), oldest first.

tools.name: nova_inbox__get_attachment
tools.description: Download one email attachment as base64 (by drive_id or index on the message).

tools.name: nova_inbox__get_inbox_address
tools.description: Return the user's Nova Inbox email address (e.g. user@nova.civai.co).

tools.name: nova_inbox__compose_message
tools.description: Send outbound email from the user's @nova.civai.co address (deterministic; no LLM draft).

tools.name: nova_inbox__converse
tools.description: Reply conversationally when the request is ambiguous or needs clarification.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "nova-inbox-agent" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nova_inbox__list_messages, nova_inbox__read_message, nova_inbox__list_thread, nova_inbox__get_attachment, nova_inbox__get_inbox_address · Public sink: nova_inbox__list_thread, nova_inbox__get_attachment, nova_inbox__get_inbox_address, nova_inbox__compose_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nova_inbox__list_messages, nova_inbox__read_message, nova_inbox__list_thread, nova_inbox__get_attachment, nova_inbox__get_inbox_address · Public sink: nova_inbox__list_thread, nova_inbox__get_attachment, nova_inbox__get_inbox_address, nova_inbox__compose_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
